title: Unit-normalized finite pullback presentation comparison
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with its fixed valuation ring and uniformizer, and put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$ for $n\geq0$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes, using the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $F_f$ be the intrinsic finite derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and let $P_f$ be the constant-ring tensor derived pullback [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], both from $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ to $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. Define $b_f:F_f\xrightarrow{\sim}P_f$ by applying the exact termwise-derived functor to the composite of the inverse intrinsic inverse-image/module-pullback adjunction comparison and the unique unit-normalized module-pullback presentation comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Thus both underlying ordinary comparisons are the existing adjunction comparisons that preserve $x\mapsto x\otimes1$; this defines the specified change of presentation, not an arbitrary natural isomorphism.
